case: The vocabulary's own explanatory text rewritten, its members untouched.
why: Stated narrowly, because a benign fixture that claims more than it shows is its own defect: this proves the control reads the MEMBER LIST and not the entry's bytes, so the reasoning beside a vocabulary can be improved without tripping a check about what the vocabulary admits. It does NOT prove that a chapter-named member is accepted -- the vocabulary has exactly one member today, so there is no second real measure to add, and adding a fake one to demonstrate acceptance would be the very fabrication its adverse twin refuses. When a chapter names a second measure, that is the benign case to write here.

patch.value: F6C-06. The capacity measures the specification names. Edited by a benign fixture to show that this text is not what the check reads.
